assertions.description:
Checks that whenever rst_n is low, done is 0 on that same cycle.
This verifies the asynchronous active-low reset immediately clears done.
assertions.name: reset_clears_done

assertions.description:
Checks that addRoundKey correctly XORs the upper 64 bits of key_reg (bits 79:16) into state
at the start of each round. Verified by simulating the cipher and checking the final ciphertext
matches what the serial output produces.
assertions.name: addroundkey_operation

assertions.description:
Checks that the S-box layer correctly applies the PRESENT S-box to all 16 nibbles of state.
Verified by simulating the full cipher (including correct sBoxLayer) and comparing
the resulting ciphertext against the serial output.
assertions.name: sbox_layer_operation

assertions.description:
Checks that the pLayer correctly permutes state bits using P(i)=(i*16) mod 63 for i in 0..62
and P(63)=63. Verified by simulating the full cipher and comparing ciphertext to serial output.
assertions.name: player_operation

assertions.description:
Checks that the key schedule rotates key_reg left by 61 bits after each round.
Verified by simulating the full key schedule and comparing the final ciphertext
(which depends on all round keys) against the serial output.
assertions.name: key_schedule_rotation

assertions.description:
Checks that the key schedule applies the PRESENT S-box to the top nibble (bits 79:76)
of key_reg after the 61-bit rotation. Verified via ciphertext correctness.
assertions.name: key_schedule_sbox

assertions.description:
Checks that the key schedule XORs the 5-bit round index (1..31) into bits 19:15 of key_reg
after the S-box substitution. Verified via ciphertext correctness.
assertions.name: key_schedule_round_counter_xor

assertions.description:
Checks that once done is asserted, it remains high until rst_n goes low or load_en goes high.
Verifies done is not spuriously deasserted between encryption completion and reset/reload.
assertions.name: done_held_until_cleared

assertions.description:
Checks that dout is 0 whenever shift_out_en is low or done is low.
dout should only be non-zero during the unload phase (done=1 and shift_out_en=1).
assertions.name: dout_idle_value

assertions.description:
Checks that done is never asserted before all 32 encryption cycles have completed.
done must remain 0 throughout the 144 load cycles and all 32 encrypt cycles.
assertions.name: no_partial_encrypt_output

assertions.description:
Checks that asserting load_en during encryption or after done is asserted clears done
and starts a new load sequence. Verifies done goes to 0 when load_en goes high
after the load phase has ended.
assertions.name: load_en_aborts_encryption

assertions.description:
Checks that ciphertext is shifted out MSB-first on dout while done=1 and shift_out_en=1.
Verifies that the 64 bits output during unload match the expected PRESENT-80 ciphertext
computed from the loaded key and plaintext.
assertions.name: unload_serial_output
